title: Task/device/media docs, examples, declarations, and release notes sync
minimumPolicy: P15-22 synchronizes v1.3 task, device, recorder, packaged media, MediaStore/playback, examples, declarations, compatibility, security, error guidance, testing, CI, and release-facing text without promoting runtime authority beyond the executable P15-12 through P15-21 evidence.

examplePolicy.rule: Task/device/media examples that rely on unpromoted task database mutation, IntentTask/broadcast registration, packaged task/broadcast mutation, notification foreground disclosure, OEM power behavior, real recorder sessions, packaged recorder stress, playback, or MediaStore must remain static, guarded, denial-oriented, or stable-denied until their source gates are promoted by future evidence.

releaseNoteState.rule: Release-facing text may mention P15-12 through P15-20 as partial evidence and P15-21 as a stable-denied decision only; it must not claim task, notification, recorder, playback, or MediaStore provider promotion.
